cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(sdl_metal_workgroup_check LANGUAGES CXX)
find_package(SDL3 CONFIG REQUIRED)
add_executable(sdl_metal_workgroup_check check.cpp)
if(NOT BBLITE_TEST_COMPILE_OPTIONS)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Pass the product-owned options from nativePosixFixtureOptions")
endif()
target_compile_options(sdl_metal_workgroup_check PRIVATE ${BBLITE_TEST_COMPILE_OPTIONS})
target_include_directories(sdl_metal_workgroup_check PRIVATE "${BBLITE_TEST_GENERATED_DIR}")
target_link_libraries(sdl_metal_workgroup_check PRIVATE SDL3::SDL3)
